target_customer: Consumers playing an online photo comparison personality game
problem: A consumer entertainment product; users choose which of two photos they like better, with no stated pain point.
business_model: Free consumer game, advertising presumed but not stated

founders.name: Sol Kennedy
founders.background_notes: Only founder named on the YC page; no background found

technical_complexity.rationale: Pairwise photo voting site; simple web application.

defensibility.rationale: Trivially copyable; a Hacker News comment in 2007 names the clone morecute.com.

market_need_then: The BBC wrote about LikeBetter around October 2006 according to a Hacker News submission dated 2006-10-09, which shows consumer curiosity; no revenue need identified.

branding.name_origin: Taken from the game prompt of choosing which photo you 'Like Better' per the YC description; no founder statement found.
branding.domain_note: likebetter.com now shows a domain marketplace page (ElectricFox Domains).
branding.community_and_virality: Covered by the BBC around October 2006 per a Hacker News link.

brand_strength.rationale: A descriptive, easy name tied to the game prompt with one notable press mention; no sustained brand activity found.

outcome_analysis: Likebetter was a two photo personality game from YC Summer 2006 that earned BBC coverage in autumn 2006 but is listed Inactive, with its domain now on a marketplace page. No post mortem, shutdown date, funding or traffic figures were found, so the cause of its end is not public in the sources checked.
notes: Competitors: only a 2007 Hacker News comment naming morecute.com was found, with no clear date inside the allowed window, so the list is empty. The YC page gives no website; likebetter.com was fetched and is a domain sale page. Funding: none found. YC location Cambridge MA per page and San Francisco per aggregators. Cause of inactivity not public.
